BiblicalUsage: The word names a covering, a veil, and it is the word of the tabernacle's doors. God commanded a hanging for the door of the tent, blue and purple and scarlet, and a covering for the gate of the court, and the veil was spread over the ark when the camp moved. The same word covers the well at Bahurim where Jonathan and Ahimaaz hid from Absalom's men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the veil is the sign of holiness and of hiding both: it covers the holy place from common eyes, and it covered two men from their enemies. I hold that God veils what is holy until He is ready to show it, and the veil He tore at the cross is the veil that kept us out.
